title: Transparency as Answerability: Role-Dependent Information Flow Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.16887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transparency in AI-supported decision systems is widely required but poorly defined. Existing approaches treat transparency as a property of systems or components, producing characteristic failures: assessments that do not transfer across organizational boundaries, stakeholder questions that cannot be formulated within the available frame of analysis, and component-level findings that say nothing about system-level behavior. We propose treating transparency as a relation: a system is transparent to a stakeholder to the degree that their legitimate questions are answerable from its structure. We formalize this using information flow networks, in which transparency questions are expressed in terms of network structure and answerability is the condition that the system settles them. translated_title: 透明性即可回答性：基于角色的信息流建模
translated_abstract: AI辅助决策系统中的透明性被广泛需求，但其定义却十分模糊。现有方法将透明性视为系统或组件的一种属性，由此产生了典型的失败情形：评估结果无法跨越组织边界进行传递，利益相关者的问题无法在现有分析框架内得到表述，组件层面的发现对系统层面的行为毫无说明。我们提出将透明性视为一种关系：系统对某利益相关者的透明程度，取决于该利益相关者的合法问题能否从系统结构中得到回答。我们使用信息流网络对这一概念进行形式化，其中透明性问题以网络结构的方式表达，而可回答性则是系统能够解决这些问题的条件。该框架支持三个分析维度：仅基于网络本身的结构性可回答性、跨越组织边界的组合性可回答性……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将AI决策系统的透明性从“系统属性”重新定义为一种“关系”——即利益相关者的合法问题能否从系统结构中得到回答，并利用信息流网络对此进行形式化建模，从而支持跨组织边界的透明性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes redefining transparency in AI-supported decision systems as a relation rather than a property—where a system is transparent to the degree that stakeholders' legitimate questions are answerable from its structure—formalized through information flow networks enabling analysis across organizational boundaries.
